title: EXCEPT & Set Difference
description: Find rows present in one query but absent in another using the EXCEPT set difference operator.

data.text: **`EXCEPT`** (equivalent to `MINUS` in Oracle) returns all distinct rows that appear in the first query result set but **do not** appear in the second query result set.

data.title: Finding Active Subscribers Who Have Not Opened Any Newsletters
data.content: Excluding engaged users using set difference.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `EXCEPT` subtracts the second query's rows from the first query's result set.
Removes duplicates by default; `EXCEPT ALL` retains duplicates.
Useful for quick ad-hoc difference checks across identical schemas.
